## Condition-Specific Monitoring Gaps

### Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: LDL Cholesterol monitoring needed (target: <100 mg/dL (or <70 if ASCVD))
- **Priority:** HIGH
- **Guideline:** ADA Standards of Care 2025
- **Last Performed:** No recent result found
- **Due:** Now
- **Details:** Part of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus management per ADA Standards of Care 2025. Monitoring schedule: HbA1c every 3-6 months. Annual: lipid panel, eGFR/Cr, urine albumin, dilated eye exam, comprehensive foot exam. Blood pressure every visit.

### Hyperlipidemia / Dyslipidemia: LDL Cholesterol monitoring needed (target: <70 mg/dL (very high risk) or <100 mg/dL (high risk) or >= 50% reduction)
- **Priority:** HIGH
- **Guideline:** 2018 ACC/AHA Cholesterol Guideline
- **Last Performed:** No recent result found
- **Due:** Now
- **Details:** Part of Hyperlipidemia / Dyslipidemia management per 2018 ACC/AHA Cholesterol Guideline. Monitoring schedule: Fasting lipid panel 4-12 weeks after starting/adjusting therapy, then every 3-12 months. ALT at baseline and as clinically indicated. Monitor for myalgias. CK if symptomatic.

### Coronary Artery Disease (Chronic CAD / Stable Ischemic Heart Disease): LDL Cholesterol monitoring needed (target: <70 mg/dL)
- **Priority:** HIGH
- **Guideline:** 2023 ACC/AHA Chronic Coronary Disease Guideline
- **Last Performed:** No recent result found
- **Due:** Now
- **Details:** Part of Coronary Artery Disease (Chronic CAD / Stable Ischemic Heart Disease) management per 2023 ACC/AHA Chronic Coronary Disease Guideline. Monitoring schedule: Lipid panel annually. Stress testing if new or worsening symptoms. Echo if HF suspected. Annual influenza vaccine. Cardiac rehab referral if post-ACS/revascularization.
